manifest.source: Complete @method, gateway-event, and VALID_HOOKS inventory projected from the exact v2026.8.3 source revision, joined to isolated-home stdio tui_gateway runtime occurrence/order evidence.

terminal.notes: Native Node Ink TUI. Semantics are never derived from terminal text.

tui-gateway.notes: JSON-RPC over stdio to tui_gateway.entry, or the same dispatcher over WebSocket handle_ws.

plugin-hook.notes: In-process plugin hooks. Default tui_gateway.entry does not load user plugins until discover_plugins runs.

shell-hook.notes: Configured shell scripts receive a serialized projection of plugin-hook kwargs and may return JSON.

outbound-webhook.notes: Notify-only hooks.outbound POSTs. Default tui_gateway.entry does not register them.

state-db.notes: HERMES_HOME/state.db is resume/replay only. Not a live event stream.

acp.notes: Separate hermes acp / hermes-acp host. Forbidden beside a native-TUI session.

artifacts.notes: Source-revision pin. Integrity is pyproject.toml of the tagged checkout, not the console-script wrapper.

claims.harness: isolated HERMES_HOME, loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, stdio tui_gateway census sidecar, plugin-hook dump and outbound webhook collector
source pin, --version, --help, rejected option, hermes acp --version/--check, Gate 0 process trees

claims.notes: Digest-pinned complete method/event/hook inventory and conservative native-schema projection. Source alone does not establish runtime reachability.

limitations: Only darwin-arm64 executed the source-revision checkout. Other platforms are declared execution environments, not separately captured binaries.
Turn captures are stdio tui_gateway, not a live hermes --tui PTY with a Node viewer attached.
Plugin hooks and outbound webhooks required the census sidecar. Default tui_gateway.entry does not register them.
Committed 0.20.0 turn fixtures are legacy privacy projections. They prove event occurrence, variants, and ordering, but are not native payload or carrier schemas.
Dynamic Python helpers prevent exact schemas for every method result and gateway event; such schemas are explicitly structural or unconstrained and retain source locations/hashes.
state.db was used for resume identity but was not snapshotted as a live event carrier.
